request.prompt: Aggressive urgent string ostinatos and rapidly pounding low toms act together, narrow chromatic repeated figures, harsh controlled violin tremolo and cutting low brass accents. Instrumental music only, no vocals, choir, speech, screams, monster sounds, weapon effects or forest ambience. No intro buildup, no outro slowdown, no final resolution.  Follow the provided source phrase timing, repeated string motif, articulation, percussion density and rhythmic drive throughout all 65 seconds. Preserve the selected urgent dark combat character from beginning to ending, with small instrumental variations only. No slower middle section, cheerful melody, new groove, sparse ambient breakdown, long rests or triumphant ending.
